data.title: 中野五月 · 雪见温泉中的红晕容颜
data.description: 飘雪冬夜的露天岩石温泉中，雪花落在热气蒸腾的泉水边缘。五月依着温润石壁浸泡在汤泉中，微醺的酡红染上双颊，眼波流转满是温软爱意。
data.action: 五月依着温润石壁浸泡在汤泉中，微醺的酡红染上双颊，眼波流转满是温软爱意
data.lighting: soft wooden lanterns glowing amid falling snow
data.promptProse: Leaning back against snow-dusted stones inside a steaming outdoor rock onsen at night, Itsuki Nakano wears a fluffy white cotton bath towel wrapped securely around her chest. With snowflakes melting along her bare shoulders and a soft, rosy blush on her cheeks, she smiles warmly under glowing wooden lanterns.
data.animaCaption: Resting against the snow-dusted rocks of the steaming outdoor bath wrapped in a fluffy white bath towel, she tilts her head toward the viewer with heat-flushed cheeks and a tender smile. Warm lantern glow illuminates drifting winter snowflakes in the mist.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a fluffy white cotton bath towel wrapped securely around her torso with bare shoulders glistening beneath melting snowflakes.
